synthesis: Two coupled defects in the single shared builder app/Support/Hits/HitsListQuery.php, used by ListHits, the HasHitMetricCards cards, Otto HitSearchTool and Otto InvestigationDataController hydration. The grep backstop found 0 missed consumers. (1) shouldUseClickhouse() (:19-23) checks Feature::active('clickhouse:hits'), a name Pennant never defines (it defines 'clickhouse-hits'), so the CH path runs only for admin_impersonator. (2) buildClickhouseQuery() (:36-75) filters only notNicb()+forKits(), never the sort-key-leading hotlist_org_id. All 4 candidates converge on one design. Route by config('app.experimental.clickhouse.hits', false) || admin_impersonator (the DEV-2591 idiom, ListScans.php:306-309). Add Hit::scopeForHotlistOrgs (mirroring Scan::scopeForOrgs, Scan.php:53-62) with hotlist_org_id IN ({user org} ∪ approval_list staging orgs ∪ silent_hit_generation orgs), ANDed with the kept kit_id IN. That set comes from the trigger rule (zod-schema.sql:2041, :1989), so it can only narrow the row set, never widen it, and Staging Live/Historical (S/Z) rows survive. No FINAL. Prod config('app.experimental.clickhouse.hits') was recorded TRUE on 2026-09-15 (docs/investigations/DEV-2546/prod-measurement-results.md:107), so the fix flips every org and Otto onto CH at deploy. Routing and prune therefore must ship together (hard stop). Open items need a human: the AC-6 prod value and rollout, the staging-org source/cache, acceptance of moved-kit/revoked-approval under-inclusion, AC-4 fix-vs-document, and measuring the prune benefit before enabling.

scope.summary: Change HitsListQuery only. Use config-based routing plus a sort-key-leading hotlist_org_id IN prune derived from PG (user org ∪ approved staging orgs ∪ silent-generation orgs), ANDed with kit_id IN. Add a Hit::scopeForHotlistOrgs scope, pin it with CH-free routing/shape tests and one RequiresClickhouse row-set class, and document every PG-vs-CH difference (AC-4). ListHits, the metric cards and both Otto consumers inherit the fix; none of them is edited.

questions.q: Which sort-key-leading predicate keeps Staging Live?
questions.answer: [SUPERSEDED — AC-2 withdrawn 2026-09-29, prune removed] hotlist_org_id IN ({user org} ∪ approval_list staging orgs ∪ silent_hit_generation orgs), ANDed with kit_id IN. L/H hits carry the kit's org; S/Z hits carry the staging org and exist only where approval_list(staging=hotlist org, agent=kit org) exists OR the hotlist org is silent (zod-schema.sql:2041, :1989). forOrg() and kit_org_id are both wrong axes.

questions.q: Derive the kit-org part from the user's org or from the kits' org_ids?

Kit::getKits filters where org_id = user org with withShared=false on the Hits path (Kit.php:252-266, User.php:183-186), so kits->pluck('org_id') ⊆ {user org}. Use the user org, with empty kits still giving 0 = 1 via forKits.

questions.q: Include silent_hit_generation staging hits in the CH list?
questions.answer: [SUPERSEDED — AC-2 withdrawn 2026-09-29, prune removed] Yes, for AC-4 parity. The PG list has no approval/silent filter (HitsListQuery.php:77-146), and the trigger generates these hits (zod-schema.sql:2041). Hit::getHits()'s silent exclusion (app/Models/Hit.php:250) is a different surface; prod has 1 silent org.

questions.q: Can the new predicate widen the row set for admin/CLIENT/impersonated users?
questions.answer: [SUPERSEDED — AC-2 withdrawn 2026-09-29, prune removed] No. getUserKits() has no role branching; impersonation logs in as the target user, and CLIENT/zero-kit orgs give 0 = 1 on both paths. The predicate is AND-only, so its failure mode is under-inclusion, never a cross-tenant leak.

notes: HARD STOP: never ship routing without the prune; never use forOrg() (hotlist_org_id = user org, which drops S/Z) or kit_org_id (not in the sort key, and it is the scan's org at write time); no FINAL.

Prod flag evidence: config('app.experimental.clickhouse.hits') = true on 2026-09-15 (docs/investigations/DEV-2546/prod-measurement-results.md:107, verified). Candidate 2's claim that no recorded prod value exists is contradicted by that file.
Org::stagingOrgIds() (Org.php:384-393) is approval_list-only with a 2h cache and 6 existing callers (incl. InvestigationDataController.php:182). Do not modify it.

Cache interplay: getUserKits is cached to end of hour (Kit::kitsCacheKey). Tests must call Kit::forgetCachedKits and clear any staging/silent cache. Otto search and hydration run the same builder, so a TTL boundary between them could, in theory, drop a found hit at hydration.

Prune benefit is unmeasured. Candidates: 'modest' (c1, idx_kit_id skip index already prunes, CH-visible L/H/S/Z ≈ 22.0M rows), 'unproven' (c2), 'matters most for Otto' (fast; HitSearchTool bounds scanned_at, not hit_created_at).

AC-4 matrix (1/3). Hit types: CH MV keeps only L/H/Z/S (hits_cold_mv.sql:83); PG excludes only O, so F 622,410 / M 55,854 / A 24,752 / P 21,602 / W 164 rows appear only on PG under Type=All. Joins: PG INNER-joins scans_metadata, client_orgs and lienholder_orgs (a NULL client/lienholder drops the row); the CH MV INNER-joins scans_cold and hotlist FINAL (org_id != 0), with watermark late-scan drops (DEV-2189).

AC-4 matrix (2/3). Status: PG reads live hotlist.status; CH reads the denormalised hotlist_status, re-emitted with lag. PG adds kits.org_id = user org for L/H with a Status filter (HitsResource.php:395-402). Disposition: PG reads scans_metadata.meta, CH reads scans_cold.disposition, and the CH default filter drops the literal 'New Hit' (Hit.php:82-91).

AC-4 matrix (3/3). Duplicates: no FINAL, and hit_created_at (mutable) is in the sort key, so a hit id can list twice (cards use uniqExact(id), so list rows ≠ card totals). kit_org_id is scan-time on CH vs current on PG (the dispositionable === check differs for moved kits). CH lacks distance_from_given_miles/nearest_given_address, so Pro HIT_ADDRESS_DISTANCE orgs move to async Path B (recovery_address type_id=2). The prune drops rows whose derivation changed (Q3). NICB: both drop NULL integration_id.
The metric cards (HasHitMetricCards) fold getFilteredTableQuery(), so they inherit the prune; their cache key derives from SQL+bindings and changes automatically.
Otto hydration: InvestigationDataController.php:133-139 uses whereIn('id')->limit(count($hitIds)). Unmerged duplicates can crowd out distinct ids (Q4).

Rejected alternatives: a per-request CH SELECT DISTINCT hotlist_org_id WHERE kit_id IN (...) (scans the table it means to prune); 'hotlist_org_id IN (...) OR hit_type IN (S,Z)' (cannot prune); a NOT IN of other orgs (fragile).

Conventions: mirror Scan::scopeForOrgs and the ListScans DEV-2615 org fallback (ListScans.php:311-331); config() not env(); PHP 8.3-safe; sparse docblocks (user preference); Pint (composer format); okf/concepts/laravel-boost-guidelines.md is the standard.

Tests: do not run automatically. RequiresClickhouse skips locally unless CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=clickhouse, so keep routing/shape/tenancy guarantees in CH-free classes. Anchor hits_hot fixtures to now() (90d TTL). There is no ApprovalListFactory; seed via the model on the zod connection.
Local CH QA: follow the current memory guidance on CH DB naming (never-use-literal-ch-dbs-for-local-qa supersedes older literal-DB notes); seed CH last and re-seed after any suite run.

The prod sort key is taken from the chlocal DDL + schema dump (they agree). A prod SHOW CREATE/EXPLAIN was not run; the scans dump once misstated its key (memory), so confirm it during the Q5 measurement.
